claims: The Saint Louis University mascot is the Billiken.
The Billiken is a mythical good-luck figure.
The Billiken has a pointed head.
The Billiken has a wide grin.
The Billiken represents "things as they ought to be".
Art teacher Florence Pretz created the Billiken in 1908.
The Billiken became Saint Louis University's official mascot around 1910.
The Billiken was a popular good luck charm according to Newswise.
The Billiken was often used as a doll or figurine according to Newswise.
According to the Saint Louis University archives, a law student/student-artist compared Saint Louis University's football coach John Bender to the Billiken.
Saint Louis University is the only university with a Billiken mascot according to Newswise.
The Saint Louis University Billiken mascot has undergone several design changes.
The Saint Louis University Billiken mascot had a 2015 update.
The Saint Louis University Billiken mascot often appears with a large joyful grin according to the Saint Louis University archives.
The University of Missouri–St. Louis mascot is Louie the Triton.
Louie the Triton was adopted in 2007.
